note: Models that the installed subscription harnesses accept (checked 2026-09-16 against claude 2.1.273 and codex-cli 0.154.0). No API key is used: each call bills the claude.ai login of the Claude Code binary or the ChatGPT login of the Codex binary. The evaluation gate binds this file by hash in the price-config slot. Neither harness exposes temperature; every call runs at the provider default.

anthropic_claude_code.auth: claude.ai OAuth login stored by the binary (claude auth status)
anthropic_claude_code.output_constraint: none: --json-schema adds a StructuredOutput tool, so the strict single-letter parser is the only constraint
anthropic_claude_code.model_source: the --model help text of the binary; the id passes through to the API verbatim and the API decides

openai_codex.auth: ChatGPT login stored in auth.json (codex login status)
openai_codex.output_constraint: codex exec --output-schema: one object with one enum field 'letter' (Responses API text.format json_schema)
openai_codex.model_source: codex debug models (the model catalog of the binary, fetched 2026-09-16)
